messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
How many euros does the verifier receive for carrying out the periodic verification of the 35,000 kg gantry crane listed at position 23?

response.text: Quanti euro riceve il verificatore per l'esecuzione della verifica periodica della gru a portale da 35.000 kg indicata alla posizione 23?
